tagline.en: Your local dev. A world of its own.

description.en: A local-first macOS desktop app that shows your running local services as buildings on floating islands. A preview exists, but there is no public download yet.
description.id: Aplikasi desktop macOS local-first yang menampilkan layanan lokal Anda sebagai bangunan di pulau melayang. Pratinjaunya sudah ada, tetapi belum ada unduhan publik.
